updates.title: CVE-2026-69851: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege via SSRF
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over a network. This is a critical flaw affecting identity infrastructure that admins should patch immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution via Unsafe Deserialization
updates.summary: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID permits unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. Organizations should prioritize patching this critical vulnerability that could lead to full identity system compromise.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Safeguard Sensitive Data from External Web Search in Copilot
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends protection to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat by preventing sensitive data from being used in external web searches. This new control helps organizations mitigate data leakage risks when users interact with AI-powered search features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: A new file quarantine action in Purview DLP automatically moves flagged files to a restricted, admin-controlled location while preserving them for review and investigation. This enforcement capability provides immediate containment of sensitive data exposure without requiring manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips Support in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available in Outlook for Mac, providing real-time notifications when email contains sensitive data that violates policies. Users receive in-context alerts with options to remediate non-compliance before sending.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging in Purview now provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions when users access the portal. This improvement helps administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Customer-Managed Keys for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for direct export workflows, allowing organizations to manage their own encryption keys instead of relying solely on Microsoft-managed encryption. This enhancement provides stronger control over sensitive data during legal holds and investigations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Security Triage Agent Confidence Scoring and Reasoning Trace
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now includes confidence scores and reasoning traces for each automated decision, enabling SOC teams to understand why the agent made a particular alert determination. This transparency helps analysts trust automation output and reduces manual review overhead.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Select User-Owned SharePoint Embedded Containers
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now select and include SharePoint Embedded content containers (from Loop, Copilot Pages, Copilot Notebooks) owned by specific individuals as data sources. This expands eDiscovery scope to cover modern content repositories previously difficult to include in legal holds.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in Exchange mailboxes, enabling preservation and versioning of historical memory data for compliance and investigation scenarios. This feature ensures organizations can maintain visibility and audit trails of AI interaction history.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Security Triage Agent Summaries in Microsoft Defender XDR
updates.summary: DLP alert summaries and categorizations from the Data Security Triage Agent are now available in Microsoft Defender XDR, centralizing alert intelligence across security tools. This integration helps SOC teams correlate identity and data loss prevention signals with broader threat detection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete via Secure Priority Cleanup Workflows
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now permanently delete OneDrive and SharePoint content through secure priority cleanup workflows with multi-administrator approval gates. This feature provides a controlled mechanism for final data purge while preventing inadvertent data loss from misconfigured policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention Based on Last Accessed
updates.summary: Retention policies can now be applied to SharePoint and OneDrive items based on when they were last accessed by users, enabling more granular data governance aligned to actual usage patterns. This allows organizations to retain frequently accessed content while purging stale files.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege via Improper Authentication
updates.summary: Improper authentication in SharePoint Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations running on-premises SharePoint should apply available patches to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering via Incorrect Authorization
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization controls in SharePoint Server permit authorized attackers to tamper with content and configurations over a network. Admins should patch this vulnerability to prevent unauthorized modifications to SharePoint environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now be tested in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing administrators to preview which items would be labeled and review match results without making changes. The new Insights tab provides performance metrics to validate policy readiness before live enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Three-Approval Requirement for Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Priority cleanup policies now require three separate approvals before permanent deletion: from a Priority Cleanup administrator, retention manager, and eDiscovery administrator. This multi-approval gate strengthens governance controls over irreversible data destruction.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Data Security with Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect and protect sensitive data in text and prompts at the network layer, blocking transmission to untrusted cloud applications. This capability extends DLP enforcement across browsers, APIs, and AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Exchange Online Classification Failure Detection
updates.summary: Exchange Online DLP policies can now detect when classification fails due to timeouts or scanning errors, and administrators can apply different protection actions for specific failure types. This visibility helps ensure DLP effectiveness is not silently compromised by backend issues.
